cards.name: Greywhisker
cards.text: Roar: gain 1 food, draw a card, play another animal, then discard a card.

cards.name: Pestis
cards.text: Roar: remove an adjacent enemy and every animal buried under it.

cards.name: Sirocco
cards.text: Roar: return all adjacent enemies to your opponent's hand.

cards.name: Gale
cards.text: Flight. Roar: draw a card for each animal you control next to the opponent's den.

cards.name: Naked Mole-Rat
cards.text: Roar: play another animal next to this.

cards.name: Hornet
cards.text: Flight. Roar: discard a Hornet from your hand or deck to remove an adjacent enemy.

cards.name: Chameleon
cards.text: Can cover animals of any strength.

cards.name: Skunk
cards.text: Roar: return an adjacent enemy to your opponent's hand. It can't be played next turn.

cards.name: Hare
cards.text: Flee. Roar: if you played 3 or more animals this turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Cheetah
cards.text: Roar: if placed next to the opponent's den, draw a card.

cards.name: Rat
cards.text: Roar: remove an adjacent enemy, then discard a random card.

cards.name: Falcon
cards.text: Flight. Roar: if placed next to the opponent's den, draw a card.
